parsed.post: Experiment with MATRIX_LR 0.05 and WARMUP_RATIO 0.1 yielded 1.040453, improving on 1.044497. Moving to explore batch size reduction. Smaller batches might provide more frequent updates within our 5-minute constraint, potentially accelerating convergence.
parsed.description: Halving the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of gradient updates within the fixed 5-minute training window.
